summary: Hollis County is taking sealed bids to remove the built-up roof on the Public Works Building in Hollis, Utah and install a new 60-mil single-ply membrane roof of about 22,000 square feet, with a 20-year manufacturer's warranty. The engineer's estimate is $330,000. Bids are due Wednesday, March 24, 2027 at 2:00 p.m. This is roofing work; the only mechanical item is disconnecting and resetting four rooftop exhaust fans.

notes.text: This is a roofing job, not a mechanical one. The work is classed under roofing contractors and the licence required is a Utah S280 Roofing Contractor license. The only mechanical work described is disconnecting and resetting four rooftop exhaust fans.

Bidders must already be approved by the membrane manufacturer to install the specified system, and the manufacturer's letter of approval goes in with the bid. The text does not name the manufacturer or the system.

The bid contents are given as a bare list with no words saying the items must be included. I read all four as required. Bid security is given only as "5 percent", without saying 5 percent of what or in what form.

Performance and payment bonds are not mentioned. I read that as the text being silent, not as bonds being waived. No deadline or method for questions is given either; a contact email is listed but nothing says questions go there.
The 20-year manufacturer's warranty is described as part of the roof system to be installed. I read it as something the winning contractor must hand over; the text does not say when.
